# Tickets

NEXT gathers pharma champions, innovators, executives, and solution providers from over 50 countries. This intimate, commercially focused event showcases where Pharma is truly moving the needle. With every edition selling out in advance, securing your ticket early ensures you don’t miss the industry’s most impactful gathering.

### Pharma Ticket

## €1590

+VAT
Buy tickets


- Full access to the Summit, Exhibition, and all Networking areas
- After-party and exclusive side events participation
- Access to summit slides, videos, and presentations after the event
- Early access to the networking platform (available 2 weeks before the event)
- A goodie bag with exclusive gifts and partner materials and many more
